Subject: Split-stay billing, VIP keycard pickup windows and guest onboarding checklist

Hi Emily + Sara —

Thanks again for working with us on the Kestrel executive workshop the week of May 11. We have a bit of a tricky rooming situation and I wanted to confirm a few operational items so the onsite run goes cleanly:

1) Split-stay / dual hotel billing: a small group of Kestrel execs (6 people) will be split between the Hilton main block and the overflow property across the street for one night (capacity constraints). We need a way to generate one master bill for Kestrel and then receive a separate invoice for the overflow rooms so Finance can route the costs correctly. Can you confirm whether the Hilton can:
  - Issue a consolidated master bill for the main block (bill to Kestrel Analytics PO) and
  - Provide a separate folio/invoice for the overflow rooms, referencing the master bill number?

2) VIP keycard pickup windows: two VIPs (arriving early on Mon 5/11) will need keycards held at bell for guaranteed access from 08:00; other attendees will check-in after 15:00. Can you outline options for an earlier key pickup (keycard hold with ID vouching vs. pre-encoded express check-in)? Any fees?

3) Luggage and staging: we’ll have onboarding materials for attendees and some welcome kits — can the hotel hold a labelled cart in a secure staging area from 07:00–18:00 on 5/11 (about 120 kits)?

4) Dietary / allergies: I attached the latest VIP dietary csv (vip-dietary-forms.csv). Please confirm how those will be tracked with the kitchen and whether the chef can get a short pre-briefing on Friday 5/8.

5) Rooming manifest cadence: I’m attaching rooming_manifest_v3.xlsx. We expect one final manifest on 5/6 and a last-minute add/drop window through 5/9. Please confirm your cutoff for billed nights and when rooming updates stop being accepted.

Action ask: can you reply with a one-paragraph confirmation of each item above and CC the on-site events manager who will be our point-of-contact? If you already have a DocuSign link for the master bill, drop it here and we’ll route to Procurement.

Appreciate it —
Marcus

Marcus Lin
Head of Events (Program Ops)
Redwood Inference

Hi Marcus / team —

Thanks for the clear notes. Quick confirmations below (and I’ve looped Miguel, our on-site events manager, who will be the POC on arrival):

1) Split-stay billing: we can do the workflow you described. We will produce a consolidated master bill (folio #MH-6267) billed to Kestrel Analytics and a separate folio for the overflow property that references the master folio. We will also provide a line-item CSV export to help you reconcile per-attendee charges for Finance.

2) VIP keycards: two options —
  - Pre-encoded express check-in: we can pre-encode keycards and hold them at the front desk; guests will only need to show photo ID (no fee).
  - Bell hold with signed authorization: if Kestrel needs keys held under a third-party name we require a signed authorization form (we can provide).
We recommend pre-encoding for the two VIPs; Miguel will staff the desk at 07:30.

3) Luggage and staging: we can reserve a locked staging room adjacent to the ballroom. We can hold and stage 120 kits from 07:00–18:00 on 5/11. Please send kit labels as a CSV and Miguel will match them on arrival.

4) Dietary: confirm received. Our executive chef will take the spreadsheet and route flagged items to the sous chef. Chef requests a 30-minute call on Fri 5/8 at 09:00 PT to review VIPs and severe allergies.

5) Rooming manifest cadence: final manifest by 23:59 PT on 5/6 to lock rooms to the master bill. Add/drops accepted through 17:00 PT on 5/9 but subject to availability; add/drop fees may apply after 5/6 per our contract (see signed-masterbill.pdf).

Attached: signed-masterbill.pdf (copy of the master bill agreement with our billing terms). DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/signed/masterbill/KA-2026-04

Let me know if that addresses everything and Miguel will send a short on-site contact card with mobile numbers.

Best,
Emily Barnes
Director, Sales & Events Operations
Hilton Downtown San Francisco
